scheme_name: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains)

Applicant must be a member of a Self‑Help Group (SHG) with at least 60% minority community members (standard requirement is 75% minority members, with the remaining 25% allowed from other weaker sections such as SC or Handicapped)
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Provides small loans of ₹1,50,000 per beneficiary to members of Self‑Help Groups (SHGs).
